تستنكرين (form X)
# تَسْتَنْكِرِينَ (tastankirīna) /tas.tan.ki.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
# تُسْتَنْكَرِينَ (tustankarīna) /tus.tan.ka.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْكَرَ (istankara)
